defs.title: Note on the Fridge
defs.author: Dana Merrow
defs.body:
Kids —
Dad went to the Okafor place to help board up. Do NOT open the front door for anyone, not even if they say it's him. Use the back. Water's in the tub. Love you. Back by dark.
— Mom

(Underneath, in pencil, smaller:)
he came back. we didnt open it. he's still on the porch.

defs.title: Ranger Station Logbook
defs.author: Dep. R. Hale
defs.body:
Day 9. Power's gone at the substation. Two more came out of the larches at dusk — slow, like sleepwalkers, until the sun went down. Then not slow.
Day 11. Locked the weapons in evidence. Key stays on me.
Day 12. Something under the hills hummed all night. Every one of them in the valley walked toward the brightest thing they could find. That was us.
Day 13. Burned the generator fuel in barrels on the north lot to draw them off. It worked. It worked too well.
Day 14. If the Cordon people come: the samples are in the cold box. Tell them the mine. Tell them it started at the mine.

defs.title: Unsent Letter
defs.author: Ifeoma Okafor
defs.body:
Chidi,
The roads are closed past the river. The radio says it's a chemical spill at the Corvane works and to stay inside. Nobody believes the radio.
The larches turned early this year. Gold all the way up the hollow. I keep thinking it's beautiful, and then I hear the neighbours.
I moved the good food to the root cellar and nailed the hatch. If you come, the key is where Papa kept the shotgun shells.
— Ife
